assumptions.text: The trial 1 failure was 'interrupted' and left no validation.json or evidence, and the target directory was empty. So this fix builds the whole milestone rather than patching a specific defect.
If the first GET /counter fails, the value display shows '—' instead of staying on 'Loading…', and the error message appears in #error.
The server passes an empty BACKEND_BASE_URL through, and config.js then uses the default http://127.0.0.1:3000.
